name: CUDA Runtime (13.4)
short: CUDA 13.4 and cuDNN 9 runtime libraries for GPU AI inference
long: Used by the ONNX-based AI processes for GPU inference through onnxruntime's CUDA provider. Requires an NVIDIA GPU and driver supporting CUDA 13. LibreDiffusion additionally needs the TensorRT Runtime package.
